The INDIA bloc will hold its planned “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on October 30 at Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence in New Delhi.
Congress MP Jairam Ramesh announced the venue change after the Congress alleged that permission to organise the event at the Ashok Hotel and Ramlila Maidan had been denied. Congress general secretary K.C. Venugopal accused the government of attempting to silence the opposition.
